title: Du'ā for Comprehensive Heart Purification
arabic: اَللّٰهُمَّ طَهِّرْ قَلْبِيْ مِنْ كُلِّ سُوْءٍ ، اَللّٰهُمَّ طَهِّرْ قَلْبِيْ مِنْ كُلِّ مَا يُبْغِضُكَ ، اَللّٰهُمَّ طَهِّرْ قَلْبِيْ مِنْ كُلِّ غِلٍّ وَحِقْدٍ وَحَسَدٍ وَكِبْرٍ
transliteration: Allāhumma ṭahhir qalbī min kulli sū', Allāhumma ṭahhir qalbī min kulli mā yubghiḍuk, Allāhumma ṭahhir qalbī min kulli ghillin wa ḥiqdin wa ḥasadin wa kibr
translation: Oh Allah, clean away all forms of evil from my heart. Oh Allah, clean my heart and remove everything that displeases you. Oh Allah, clean my heart of every form of bitterness, hard feelings, jealousy, and arrogance.
